headline: Mike McFarland, the voice behind Master Roshi in the English dub of Dragon Ball, has passe
body: Mike McFarland, the voice behind Master Roshi in the English dub of Dragon Ball, has passed away at 56. 🕊️💔 His work was part of countless fans’ childhoods, bringing characters like Master Roshi and Yajirobe to life alongside Buggy in One Piece and Jean Kirstein in Attack on Titan. Beyond the microphone, McFarland also worked as a voice director, helping shape the English dubs of beloved anime including Fullmetal Alchemist, Attack on Titan and Tokyo Ghoul. His contributions reached far beyond the characters fans recognized him for. Sending love to his family, friends, colleagues and everyone who grew up hearing his voice. Rest in peace, Mike. ❤️
